# 🎮 v0.2.0 - Every style, all the way through

Hey everyone, s1moscs here.

In 0.1.0 a style dressed the main pages, and agent select, the match report or the chat still looked like plain ValoShell. **In 0.2.0 every style goes all the way through: its own agent select, lobby, match report, news, progress and chat, plus two new styles, in-app updates and chat with your party and friends.**

---

## Two new styles

- **Phantom:** Persona 5's menus. Huge slanted cut-out words, ransom-note names and a calling card for your party.
- **Night City:** a Cyberpunk netrunner interface, with a vendor store sorted by rarity.

That's sixteen styles. Switch any time from the brush button at the top right.

## Every style, every screen

- **Switching style now changes everything:** agent select, the live match and the match report all switch to that style's own pieces.
- **The match report speaks each game's language:** Minecraft's "You Died!", Fortnite's "#1 Victory Royale", CS:GO's MVP stars.
- **New store and career looks:** a Pip-Boy barter screen, a Cyberpunk vendor, CS:GO's Panorama profile and CS2's Premier rating with its graph.
- **Minecraft trading has a tab for every shelf** (daily, bundle, Night Market, accessories) and shows discounts the way villagers do.

## Chat

- **Party chat, your team in agent select, and whispers with friends,** in a resizable panel with unread counts.
- **Every style has its own chat line** on Home, and the chat panel is dressed to match (a frosted Glass card, an olive CS 1.6 window, Pip-Boy phosphor...).
- **Chat never reveals a hidden name:** players show only as the menu already names them, and whispers are with friends only.

## Updates from inside the app

ValoShell now tells you when a new release is out and shows its notes. Installing downloads the new exe, checks it against the release's SHA-256 sums and restarts into it. **It only ever happens when you click, never mid-match**, and you can turn the check off in the Esc menu.

> [!NOTE]
> **Coming from 0.1.0?** The updater is new in this release, so download this one by hand. From here on, ValoShell offers updates itself.

## Your loadout and your account

- **Loadout presets:** save your whole loadout (skins, chromas, buddies, card, title, spray wheel) and equip it again in one click.
- **Card, title, sprays and buddies** can be changed from the menu, with one picker for all of them.
- **A wishlist** that tells you when a skin you want is in your store. It stays in ValoShell; nothing is sent to Riot.
- **Stats** over your recent matches (K/D, ACS, headshot %, ADR, win rate), by agent and by map.
- **The leaderboard** for your region this act.
- **Friend requests:** accept, decline, cancel, or add someone by Riot ID.
- **A notice when your account is restricted** (queue ban, queue delay, ranked or chat restriction) and when it lifts, so a failed queue tells you why.

## Studio

- **Community looks:** the gallery lists themes other players shared, and you can share yours through GitHub. Every shared look is checked before use, so it can only change colours and layout.
- **Recolour any style** role by role, give pieces their own motion, and pick backdrops from your last match.
- **Starter looks** and a live preview in the gallery.

## Comfort and streaming

- **Interface size, high contrast and colour-vision palettes** in the Esc menu.
- **Effects quality:** Auto turns blur and moving backdrops off on a PC that can't keep the menu smooth.
- **Party codes no longer leak:** never in logs or toasts, and in streamer mode the code is blurred and the join field shows dots.
- **Streamer mode blurs every player name** in every style, including a few that showed through in 0.1.0.
- **Dodge asks for a second click,** so a stray click can't cost you RR and a queue ban.

> [!NOTE]
> **The "Enemy ranks in agent select" setting is gone.** Riot only sends your own team during agent select, so it could never show anything. Enemy ranks still appear once the match starts.

## Fixes

Lots of them. The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Soulhackzlol/ValoShell/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#020---2026-11-24), but the ones you'd notice:

- The VALORANT store's daily offers go on your wishlist with a click, instead of buttons that only said "buy in the game".
- The menu no longer flickers when it comes back after a match.
- Backdrops no longer drift with the mouse.
- Small labels no longer shrink below readable size.

---

## How it works

Same as before: ValoShell talks to the **Riot Client already running on your PC**, through the same local API the official client uses.

- **Nothing to log in to.** Your session comes from the Riot Client.
- **Nothing touches the game.** No injection, no memory reading, no input automation.
- **No unfair extras.** No instalock, nothing bought from the menu, and streamer mode only ever hides names.

> [!WARNING]
> ValoShell isn't endorsed by Riot. It only does what the official client can, but it's a third-party tool, so use it at your own discretion.

---

## Getting started

1. Download `ValoShell-v0.2.0.exe` below.
2. Start VALORANT's Riot Client.
3. Open ValoShell.

> [!TIP]
> **"Windows protected your PC"?** The build isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen warns about it. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. If nothing opens at all, install Microsoft's [WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/) (Windows 11 already has it).

---

> ValoShell is open source and the build isn't code-signed, so Windows Defender may show a false positive on first download OR even block it.
